thread:
emma_cs: urgent — NewTide Labs started seeing 502s from EU customers during a partner demo at 09:50 UTC. They want a quick EU edge + a temporary QPS uplift for the demo window. renewal review in ~10 days, they're nervous.

jorge_se: any metrics? which endpoints were affected?

emma_cs: Mostly /v1/chat and websocket streams. They logged ~130 rps sustained for 12m with spikes to 280rps. errors look like proxy gateway timeouts hitting eu cluster (504/502). Customer asked for "eu-edge + temp 2x qps" for 24h starting ASAP.

hana_netops: We can bring up eu-south-1-edge quickly and add NewTide IPs to allowlist. need CIDRs + exact window. Recommend ACL auto-revoke after 24h.

emma_cs: CIDRs: 88.198.32.0/22, 203.119.75.128/26. Start: today 11:15 UTC -> end +24h.

hana_netops: ack. i'll create ACL entry "newtide-demo-5201" and apply to eu-south-1-edge. planning rule id acl-11002 with revoke at +24h.

jorge_se: For safety: set a per-route token QPS override rather than account-wide increase. i'll push route override x2 and pin them to burst pool. also enable request-level retries (2) for demo traffic.

rick_infra: can spin up 2 small burst nodes in eu-south-1 and tag newtide-burst-5201. will disable autoscale for demo window. i'll open INC-4705 and tag eng-sre for real-time monitoring.

ticket-bot: Incident created: INC-4705 "NewTide demo: eu-edge allowlist + temp QPS override" by rick_infra. ETA: 50m.

emma_cs: also add renewal note: they explicitly said performance will inform renewal decision. set renewal_risk: high.

hana_netops: ACL applied to eu-south-1-edge, rule acl-11002. please confirm customer test.

emma_cs: shared test window and curl snippet with their ops: test at 11:20 UTC.

emma_cs: curl sample i sent:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEWTIDE_DEMO" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-conv","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"smoke test"}]}'
```

jorge_se: i'll tail traces and token latency for the route. if errors continue we can fallback them to hosted-eu-replica and revert the qps to a safer level.

rick_infra: burst nodes up, route override pushed, retries enabled, auto-revoke scheduled +24h. closing loop after verification. :white_check_mark:

emma_cs: thanks team — i'll capture post-demo feedback and log details in the renewal tracker + add notes to the enablement playbook. :memo:
